# apicp_mail_domain (Resource)

Manages a mail domain (Postfix + Dovecot, SQL-backed virtual maps) via apicp. Creates a dedicated Unix user for this domain's mailbox storage — see `unix_user`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_mail_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

# New mail stored compressed (zstd at its default level 3; needs apicp v0.8.0).
# Mail already stored is compressed with `apicp mail compress-existing --domain archive.example.com`.
resource "apicp_mail_domain" "archive" {
  name        = "archive.example.com"
  compression = "zstd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Mail domain, e.g. `example.com`. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `compression` (String) How new mail of this domain is stored: `off` (default), `zstd`, `lz4`, `gz` or `bz2` (Dovecot's mail_compress plugin; mail programs notice nothing). `zstd` (level 3) is the right choice almost always: as small as gzip, about ten times faster. `lz4` uses the least CPU and saves less; `gz` for compatibility; high zstd levels only for archive mailboxes; `bz2` has no advantage. Only methods the server's Dovecot can write are accepted (`apicp_mail_settings.compression_methods`). Mail already stored is not changed: compress or decompress it with `apicp mail compress-existing` / `decompress-existing` (a one-off job, deliberately not a Terraform resource); turning compression off keeps compressed mail readable. Cannot change while such a job of the domain runs. Needs apicp v0.8.0.
- `compression_level` (Number) The method's level: `zstd` 1-22, `gz` 1-9, `bz2` 1-9 (block size); `lz4` and `off` take none. `0` (default) = the method's own default (zstd 3, gz 6, bz2 9).
- `disable_imap` (Boolean) Switch IMAP off for every mailbox in this domain (logins over IMAP fail; webmail uses IMAP, so it stops too). Mail is still delivered. Default `false`.
- `disable_pop3` (Boolean) Switch POP3 off for every mailbox in this domain. Mail is still delivered. Default `false`.
- `max_emails_per_hour` (Number) Outgoing mail (recipients) from this domain's mailboxes and its website over a rolling hour, on top of the account's package `max_emails_per_hour`. Mail over it is refused for now (451): a website's mail stays queued and goes out later by itself, a mail program keeps it in its Outbox to send again. `0` (default) = unlimited.

### Read-Only

- `compressed_mail` (Boolean) Some of the domain's stored mail may be compressed (compression was on, or compress-existing ran, since the last whole-domain decompress-existing that left nothing compressed). apicp backups store such a domain's mail decompressed.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
- `unix_user` (String) Dedicated Unix user apicp created for this domain's mailbox storage.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apicp_mail_domain.example mdom_abc123
```
